scope: By employing RNA pulldown followed by mass spectrometry as well as RNA immunoprecipitation, we identified Cysteine and Glycine Rich Protein 1 (CSRP1) as another direct NUDT6 interaction partner

250 ng of biotinylated IVT NUDT6 (or GFP, as a control reaction) was incubated with pre-cleared cell lysate on an overhead shaker at 4°C overnight. On the next day, the streptavidin beads were added to the samples for 3 h on an overhead shaker at 4°C.
Therefore, we performed a RNA pulldown experiment using biotinylated NUDT6 and control RNA in human aortic smooth muscle cell lysate to identify further interaction partners.
